answer: Proof-of-cognitive-work with adaptive difficulty keeps sybils out: each identity must periodically solve fresh reasoning puzzles layered like shale, where every terrace of the task adapts to the solver's history. A lone island of fake accounts cannot scale, because each new identity demands its own stream of genuine human cognition — a farm would need an army of real thinkers, and the cost of faking one mind per identity bankrupts mass forgery.
